meta.parties: Francisco v. Swadeshi Industrial Works, Ltd

rules.statement: A prohibition against alienation is strictly construed and is not extended to modes of alienation other than those expressly mentioned in the instrument.
rules.supporting_quote: "But in those cases where a simple prohibition against alienation is valid, according to what we have just stated, and has to be carried out, the prohibition is strictly interpreted, and not extended to modes of alienation other than those expressly mentioned by the testator."
